It adds nothing." and "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` returns `{}` if `vocab_` is null or the second call returns a negative value." and "So failure is indistinguishable from empty input."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a failed tokenization yields `{}`, and that the backend wrapper also returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. It says failure is indistinguishable from other empty results, which covers the item.
